coverageNotes: Tests applying the supplied ctx.db.system.get() reader to the storage table and ID, plus choosing the download-URL ID. Does not test recalling the metadata-reader API, upload flow or missing-file errors. Tests separate storage/application row lifecycles; does not test upload UI or concurrent deletion.

questions.context: Using Convex 1.44.0 inside a query, file is a loaded Doc<"files">. The files table contains only storageId: v.id("_storage"). The stored object exists. The task supplies ctx.db.system.get() for retrieving storage metadata.
questions.question: Which code reads its download URL and storage metadata?

options.rationale: getUrl needs the storage ID, not the application files-row ID.
System metadata requires db.system; the ordinary db.get reader rejects system-table access.
This returns the linking application row, not size/hash/content-type metadata.
Both calls address the stored object using its storage ID, with db.system reading its metadata.

questions.context: Using Convex 1.44.0 inside a mutation, file is a loaded Doc<"files"> with an existing storageId. The files schema has only storageId: v.id("_storage").
questions.question: Which code deletes both this stored object and its files row?

options.rationale: Deleting the stored object leaves the application row.
Deleting the application row leaves the stored object.
The object and application row have separate APIs and IDs, so both are explicitly removed.
The second call uses a storage ID where a files-row ID is required; the transaction fails.
